forwardPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance forward EPS estimate.
forwardPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and forward EPS estimate fields

pnAv.label: P/NAV
pnAv.limitation: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.
pnAv.method: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.

priceToBook.label: P/B
priceToBook.limitation: Book value is not NAV, replacement value, fleet value, or reviewed accounting equity.
priceToBook.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance book value per share.
priceToBook.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and bookValue fields

priceToSalesTrailing12Months.label: P/S
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.limitation: Revenue multiples need margin, growth, sector, and accounting context.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.method: Computed as market cap divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

targetUpsidePct.label: Target-derived fields
targetUpsidePct.limitation: Target rows are provider/manual source rows. Reported analyst references may overlap and are not deduplicated.
targetUpsidePct.method: Unknown from Yahoo/yfinance response. Treat as a third-party consensus field and verify against other sources.

trailingPE.label: TTM P/E
trailingPE.limitation: Trailing EPS can differ from company adjusted EPS and may include one-offs.
trailingPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance trailing EPS.
trailingPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and EPS fields
